candidates.change_summary: Change the stored target block from block.number + 1 to block.number + 2, so the recorded block (and later settlement semantics) differ.
Delete the assignment of the guess hash so the stored guess remains its previous value (bytes32(0)) while the block is still set.
Change the stored target block to the current block number, so the guess is recorded for a different block than the original.
Delete the statement resetting guesses[msg.sender].block to 0, allowing repeated settle calls.
Change the payout amount from 2 ether to 1 ether.
Invert the win condition from equality to inequality of guess and answer.
Relax the time check from strictly greater to greater-or-equal, allowing settlement in the target block itself.
Delete the require that guesses[msg.sender].block is nonzero, letting fresh accounts settle using block 0.
